instruction: Flag each email in the Bills folder for follow-up

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 13) = (select count(*) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13));

metadata.explanation: Task requires flagging all emails in the Bills folder (folderID=13) for follow-up. The evaluator verifies that ALL emails in folder 13 have the star/flag attribute (attributeID=58) set to 1 by comparing the total count of emails in the folder with the count of flagged emails. This is verified via SQL query on the Thunderbird global-messages-db.sqlite database. In Thunderbird, the star is used for flagging messages.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly verifies that ALL emails in folder 13 are flagged by comparing total email count with flagged email count

Query logic: (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 13) = (select count(*) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13))
Evaluator provides complete coverage: checks that every single email in the Bills folder has the flag/star attribute (attributeID=58) set to 1
Data extraction is correct: getter retrieves Thunderbird SQLite database, run_sqlite3 executes query and returns 1.0 if all emails flagged, 0.0 otherwise
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure database is accessible and not locked during evaluation
Metadata explanation accurately describes the verification logic
